purpose: Formal conformance substrate for negotiation-ref-v1. An external implementer who reproduces negotiation_ref byte-identical from the stated negotiation_artifact has a conformant implementation. The action_ref is derived independently from the four preimage fields — negotiation_ref never enters the preimage.
reproduce_in_python:
import hashlib, json
def jcs(obj): return json.dumps(obj, separators=(',',':'), sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False)
# negotiation_ref: only defined when negotiation_artifact is not null (present case).
# When negotiation_artifact is null (negotiation-003-absent), there is nothing to hash --
# negotiation_ref in the envelope is the literal JSON null, not a derived value, and the
# verifier's output field is negotiation_linkage: "absent", not a recomputed hash.
if negotiation_artifact is not None:
    negotiation_ref = hashlib.sha256(jcs(negotiation_artifact).encode()).hexdigest()
else:
    negotiation_ref = None
# action_ref (both present and absent cases) is independent of negotiation_ref/negotiation_artifact:
action_ref = hashlib.sha256(jcs(action_preimage).encode()).hexdigest()

vectors.description: Synthetic capability-grant handshake: giskard-self grants pioneer-agent-001 authority to execute delegation.execute within scope mycelium:delegation, expiring 2026-05-27. This is the minimal reference artifact for negotiation-ref-v1. The negotiation_ref hash commits to the artifact only — not to the trail record. The action that follows this grant has a separate action_ref derived from its own four preimage fields.

invariants.negotiation_ref_not_in_preimage: negotiation_ref does not appear in action_preimage — action_ref is determined solely by action_type, agent_id, scope, timestamp
invariants.independent_hashes: negotiation_ref = SHA-256(JCS(negotiation_artifact)); action_ref = SHA-256(JCS(action_preimage)); neither hash is derived from the other

notes.negotiation_artifact: Synthetic capability-grant — serves as reference artifact for negotiation-ref-v1. Format is implementer-defined; only the JCS+SHA-256 derivation is normative.
notes.tx_hash: Real Base mainnet anchor (pioneer-agent-001 Oasis payment 2026-04-13). Used as canonical tx_hash reference across fixtures.
notes.expires_at: Grant expires 2026-05-27 — within the CTEF synthesis window, intentional.

vectors.description: MUST-FAIL vector: identical negotiation_artifact to negotiation-001-capability-grant except expires_at advanced by one day (simulates a post-grant tamper). Proves negotiation_ref is load-bearing, not decorative — a single-field mutation MUST produce a negotiation_ref that differs from the original, never a collision.
vectors.assertion: negotiation_ref of this vector MUST NOT equal a0e8bc2658eee9266d87d56b205a5f01e5b1ecc445f0693b3bba46cb8764ad52 (negotiation-001-capability-grant's negotiation_ref) — a conformant implementation that produces a collision here is non-conformant regardless of what it does with the positive vector.

notes.credit: Vector shape suggested by babyblueviper1, ethereum/ERCs#1810 (2026-08-13) — a tampered negotiation_artifact recomputing to a DIFFERENT negotiation_ref, proving the hash is load-bearing.
notes.why_this_field: expires_at chosen because it is the field most likely to be silently bumped post-grant in a real integration (extension request handled by mutating the record instead of issuing a new one) — the failure mode this vector guards against is realistic, not synthetic.

vectors.description: A trail record with no upstream negotiation artifact — negotiation_ref was never supplied. Exercises invariant 5: the absent/present distinction MUST surface in the verifier's output as an explicit field, not be left implicit in 'the key is missing from the JSON'. envelope.negotiation_ref is explicitly null (present as a key with value null, not omitted) — a conformant verifier reading this envelope MUST report negotiation_linkage: "absent", the same string the reference implementation (mycelium_trails.verify_chain()) returns for this case, exercised in tests/test_negotiation_linkage_status.py::test_verify_chain_reports_absent_when_no_negotiation_ref.

invariants.negotiation_ref_optional: negotiation_ref is null when not supplied — its absence makes no claim about whether an upstream agreement exists or not (invariant 4)
invariants.linkage_must_be_explicit: a conformant verifier MUST expose negotiation_linkage: "absent" as its own explicit output field for this envelope — reporting the trail as valid with no mention of negotiation_ref, or simply omitting the key, is non-conformant (invariant 5)

notes.credit: Gap and the absent/present distinction motivated by Henri Sirkkavaara (draft-sirkkavaara-vaara-receipt, scitt@ietf.org thread on draft-fassbender-scitt-time-anchor-03, 2026-08-14) — argued for time-anchor receipts, applied to negotiation_ref in negotiation-ref.md invariant 5 the same day. Henri requested this exact case (absent vs. claimed-unresolved) as a standalone recomputable fixture, scitt@ietf.org, 2026-08-16, for cross-checking against his own conformance checker.
notes.why_this_matters: before invariant 5 was written, the reference implementation could report a trail as valid without any signal that no negotiation artifact backs it — indistinguishable from a verifier that simply forgot to check. This vector is the exchange-format proof that the distinction is real and reproducible outside our own code.

vectors.description: Same shape as negotiation-001-capability-grant, but negotiation_ref is set to a string that is not the hash of any known real artifact — no negotiation_artifact backs it, it was never derived via JCS+SHA-256 from anything. Exercises invariant 3: Mycelium is opaque to the referenced artifact and never fetches, parses, or validates it. A conformant verifier reading this envelope MUST still report negotiation_linkage: "present" — "present" means the field was supplied, not that the referenced artifact was verified. Reference: tests/test_negotiation_linkage_status.py::test_negotiation_linkage_present_but_unverified_by_construction, same nonsense string.

invariants.opaque_to_mycelium: Mycelium stores negotiation_ref verbatim as a TEXT field, with no schema validation, no fetch, and no cross-reference check against any artifact (invariant 3)
invariants.present_not_verified: "present" means the field was supplied, not that the referenced artifact was verified — a nonsense negotiation_ref produces the exact same negotiation_linkage: "present" as a real one (invariant 3, surfaced via invariant 5's reporting requirement)

notes.credit: Same distinction motivated by Henri Sirkkavaara (scitt@ietf.org, 2026-08-14/16) as negotiation-003-absent above — this vector is the present-but-unverified half of the pair he asked for, proving 'present' is not a verification claim.
notes.why_this_field: no negotiation_artifact is given for this vector deliberately — the point is that negotiation_ref does not need one to be accepted and reported as "present"; supplying a real artifact here would undercut the vector's purpose.

vectors.description: A trail_id that was never resolvable — the underlying record could not be read at all, as distinct from negotiation-003-absent where the record IS read and negotiation_ref is found missing. There is no negotiation_artifact, no action_preimage, no envelope: nothing was ever committed to read. Exercises the third state Aleksei Chirkunov (scitt@ietf.org, 2026-08-16) pointed out was collapsing into negotiation-003's 'absent' output: verify_chain() must distinguish 'record read, field missing' (absent) from 'record never reached' (unreached), reported as negotiation_linkage: null. Reference implementation: mycelium_trails.verify_chain(), exercised in tests/test_negotiation_linkage_status.py::test_negotiation_linkage_none_when_trail_id_unreached.

invariants.unreached_distinct_from_absent: negotiation_linkage: null (unreached) MUST NOT be reported as "absent" — "absent" (negotiation-003) asserts the record was read and the field was missing; null asserts the record itself was never reached, a strictly weaker claim.
invariants.no_envelope_when_unreached: there is no action_ref, preimage, or envelope for this vector — an unreached trail has nothing to hash, unlike negotiation-003-absent and negotiation-004-present-unverified, which both have a real committed envelope.

notes.credit: Reported by Aleksei Chirkunov (scitt@ietf.org, 2026-08-16) — the fixture had vectors for negotiation_artifact present (negotiation-001) and absent-but-read (negotiation-003), but none for a trail_id that could never be read at all. Same report also caught the empty-string-vs-missing distinction (negotiation_linkage: "malformed"), fixed in PR#55 but not carried into this fixture as a separate vector — malformed still requires a readable record with negotiation_ref="", which negotiation-003's shape already implies; unreached does not.
notes.vocabulary: using None (Python)/null (JSON) rather than a string literal "unreached", matching mycelium_trails.verify_chain()'s actual return value and tests/test_negotiation_linkage_status.py — not copying Chirkunov's record_supplied: false shape verbatim.
